# Jury Reporting Instructions

# **For Date: MONDAY, JUNE 1, 2026**

## \*\*IF YOU ARE USING THE A&D PARKHAUS GARAGE FOR PARKING DO NOT FORGET TO APPLY THE PROMO CODE JURY7 WHEN PAYING FOR PARKING TO OBTAIN THE JURY DISCOUNTED PARKING RATE.  DO NOT PRE-PAY FOR PARKING.  YOU MUST PAY AFTER YOU HAVE PARKED.  IF YOU CAN NOT OBTAIN A $7 RATE FROM INSIDE THE GARAGE PLEASE STOP WHAT YOU ARE DOING, COME TO THE JURY COMMISSION OFFICE, AND WE CAN HELP YOU OBTAIN THE DISCOUNTED RATE\*

## PETIT JURORS, TO FIND YOUR GROUP NUMBER PLEASE CHECK YOUR SUMMONS.  APPROXIMATELY 1 INCH BELOW THE BARCODE YOU WILL SEE THE WORD "GROUP" FOLLOWED BY A 3 DIGIT NUMBER.  THIS IS YOUR GROUP NUMBER FOR THE PURPOSES OF CHECKING OUR REPORTING INSTRUCTIONS.

## PETIT JURORS WHO ARE IN GROUP(S) 611, 612, AND 613 MUST REPORT TO THE JURY COMMISSION OFFICE LOCATED IN ROOM 455 OF THE HAMILTON COUNTY COURTHOUSE MONDAY BY 8:30 AM.

## THOSE REMAINING PETIT JURORS IN GROUP 614, 615, AND 616 DO NOT NEED TO REPORT ON MONDAY.  YOU ARE NOT FINISHED WITH YOUR JURY SERVICE.  YOU MUST CHECK THIS WEB PAGE AFTER 3:00 PM ON MONDAY OR CALL 513-946-5879 AFTER 4:00 PM ON MONDAY FOR TUESDAY’S REPORTING INSTRUCTIONS.

## HAVE A GREAT DAY!
